scripts.text:
[De Thomas]
Oh, it's you?
Long time no see!
You seem healthier than before.
Hahahaha!
Take care! See you again!
scripts.translation:
[德·托馬斯]
哦，是你啊？
好久不見了！
你看起來比以前更健康了。
哈哈哈哈哈！
保重！下次再見！

scripts.text:
[De Thomas]
Welcome back...
Are you ready to learn Body Movin'?
scripts.translation:
[德·托馬斯]
歡迎回來...
你準備好學習“移動時恢復HP”了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No, I'm not ready yet.
scripts.translation: 不，我還沒準備好

scripts.text:
[De Thomas]
Let's see.....
scripts.translation:
[德·托馬斯]
讓我看看.....

scripts.text:
[De Thomas]
Ok! I shall now teach you...
...The Body Movin' skill!
scripts.translation:
[德·托馬斯]
好的！我現在就教你...
...“移動時恢復HP”這個技能！

scripts.text:
[De Thomas]
There you go!
Try it yourself.
But don't overdo it.
scripts.translation:
[德·托馬斯]
就是這樣！
你自己試試看。
不過別太勉強了。

scripts.text:
[De Thomas]
Oh yeah, I won't be needing your
armor so you can keep it.
Good luck now!
scripts.translation:
[德·托馬斯]
對了，我不需要你的盔甲了，你可以留著。
祝你好運！

scripts.text:
[De Thomas]
Is that so?
Then come when you are prepared.
scripts.translation:
[德·托馬斯]
是嗎？
那你準備好後再來吧。

scripts.text:
[De Thomas]
Hmmm... He's a swordsman...
You know that I am De Thomas Carlos, right?
Knight of Prontera's 3rd Calvary.
De Thomas Carlos!
scripts.translation:
[德·托馬斯]
嗯...他是個劍士...
你知道我是德·托馬斯·卡洛斯吧？
普隆德拉第三騎兵隊的騎士。
德·托馬斯·卡洛斯！

scripts.text:
[De Thomas]
You do not have all the items I asked for.
scripts.translation:
[德·托馬斯]
你還沒有集齊我要求的所有物品。

scripts.text:
[De Thomas]
Remember, I need ^008800200 empty bottles^000000, your armor, and a ^008800Moth Wing^000000. Come back when you have it all.
scripts.translation:
[德·托馬斯]
記住，我需要^008800200個空瓶^000000、你的盔甲，以及^0088001只蛾子翅膀^000000。集齊了再來找我。

scripts.text:
[De Thomas]
My name is De Thomas Carlos.
Knight of Prontera's 3rd Calvary.
I have a certain duty these days.
Ehem! Need I say more.
scripts.translation:
[德·托馬斯]
我叫德·托馬斯·卡洛斯。
普隆德拉第三騎兵隊的騎士。
最近我有一項特定的職責。
咳！還需要我多說什麼嗎。

scripts.text:
[De Thomas]
Oh, no! You must have been hurt! Are you ok?
You must have fought hard to get such serious injuries..
Being a swordsman must come with a lot of responsibility and sacrifice.
scripts.translation:
[德·托馬斯]
哦，不！你受傷了！沒事吧？
你一定經歷了一場惡戰才會受這麼重的傷...
身為劍士，必然伴隨著許多責任與犧牲。

scripts.text:
[De Thomas]
For these swordsmen and knights, there is a wonderful skill.
I present to you - HP Recovery While Moving!
Body moving is a splendid skill
that allows you to regain strength(HP)
while you are moving!
scripts.translation:
[德·托馬斯]
對於你們這些劍士和騎士來說，有一個很棒的技能。
我向你展示——移動時恢復HP！
移動時恢復HP是一個絕妙的技能，它能讓你們在移動中恢復體力（HP）！

scripts.text:
[De Thomas]
For these swordswomen and knights, there is a wonderful skill young lady.
I present to you - HP Recovery While Moving!
Body moving is a splendid skill
that allows you to regain strength(HP)
while you are moving!
scripts.translation:
[德·托馬斯]
對於你們這些女劍士和騎士來說，有一個很棒的技能，年輕女士。
我向你展示——移動時恢復HP！
移動時恢復HP是一個絕妙的技能，它能讓你們在移動中恢復體力（HP）！

scripts.text:
[De Thomas]
It is currently under development
so it may not recover that much,
but it will help a little.
What do you think? Would you like to learn this skill?
scripts.translation:
[德·托馬斯]
目前這個技能還在開發中，所以恢復量可能不會太多，但多少會有點幫助。
你覺得怎麼樣？想學這個技能嗎？

scripts.text: What a nice skill! I want to learn it!
scripts.translation: 這技能真不錯！我想學！

scripts.text: No, thank you.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝

scripts.text:
[De Thomas]
Very well. I will tell you what you need to learn this skill.
First, your job level must be higher than ^00880035^000000.
You will also need ^008800200 empty bottles^000000.
Why? Because it is proof that you fought fiercely to have used that many potions.
scripts.translation:
[德·托馬斯]
很好。我會告訴你學習這個技能需要什麼。
首先，你的職業等級必須高於^00880035^000000。
你還需要^008800200個空瓶^000000。
為什麼？因為這是你激烈戰鬥並消耗了大量藥水的證明。

scripts.text:
[De Thomas]
Also, the armor you used in battle.
This is also proof of an experienced fighter.
For the armor... your armor is perfect!
Bring your armor!
Last but not least... bring me one ^008800Moth Wing^000000.
scripts.translation:
[德·托馬斯]
還有，你在戰鬥中使用的盔甲。
這也是經驗豐富的戰士的證明。
至於盔甲...你的盔甲正合適！
帶上你的盔甲！
最後但同樣重要的是...給我帶一隻^008800蛾子翅膀^000000。

scripts.text: Eh? You need that, too?
scripts.translation: 呃？你還需要那個？

scripts.text:
[De Thomas]
Not really.. I don't really NEED it.
It's just that my niece has gotten a bug hunting as a holiday task during the summer vacation.
Of course! It would be much easier for me to get it myself.
but I must work here all the time so I don't exactly have the time to go out and get it.
scripts.translation:
[德·托馬斯]
其實...我並不是真的“需要”它。
只是我侄女暑假的假期作業是捉蟲子。
當然！我自己去抓會容易得多。
但我一直在這裡工作，實在沒時間去外面抓。

scripts.text:
[De Thomas]
Don't you think it is pitiful that I have to stay in once place everyday, not being able to go outside?
Please, find me one...*sniffsniff*
If you don't...
scripts.translation:
[德·托馬斯]
你覺得我每天都只能待在一個地方，不能出去，是不是很可憐？
拜託了，幫我找一隻...*吸鼻子*
如果你不找的話...

scripts.text:
[De Thomas]
...
scripts.translation:
[德·托馬斯]
...

scripts.text:
[Leon]
Eh?
I was wondering who that was!
Why it's you from before!
Nice to see you again! How are you?
Be careful! Hahaha!
scripts.translation:
[雷恩]
咦？
我在想那是誰呢！
原來是你啊，之前見過的那個！
很高興再次見到你！最近怎麼樣？
小心點！哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Leon]
Ooh! You are more than ready
to learn Fatal Blow!
So how about it? Would you like to learn?
scripts.translation:
[雷恩]
哦！你已經完全準備好學習攻擊弱點了！
那麼，怎麼樣？你想學嗎？

scripts.text: Yes!
scripts.translation: 帶了！

scripts.text: No, I don't want to.
scripts.translation: 不，我不想學

scripts.text: But, what is Fatal Blow?
scripts.translation: 但是，攻擊弱點是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Leon]
OK, lets begin!
scripts.translation:
[雷恩]
好的，我們開始吧！

scripts.text:
[Leon]
Success!
Go use your new skill to its full potential.
Hahahahahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[雷恩]
成功！
去充分發揮你新技能的作用吧。
哈哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Leon]
I don't like you!!!
scripts.translation:
[雷恩]
我不喜歡你！！！

scripts.text:
[Leon]
I developed this skill recently.
When you use bash, depending 
on your level, you can stun 
your opponent. .
You have learned bash, haven't you?
scripts.translation:
[雷恩]
這是我最近開發的技能。
當你使用狂擊時，根據你的等級，你可以使對手眩暈。
你已經學會狂擊了吧？

scripts.text:
[Leon]
What do you think. Stun is
a very useful technique. Don't you find this skill attractive?
When you think you do, just come right back to me!
scripts.translation:
[雷恩]
你覺得怎麼樣？眩暈是一項非常實用的技術。你不覺得這個技能很有吸引力嗎？
當你覺得可以的時候，直接回來找我吧！

scripts.text:
[Leon]
Ooh! A young and strong swordsman!
scripts.translation:
[雷恩]
哦！一位年輕而強壯的劍士！

scripts.text:
[Leon]
Wow, seeing your arm, you must enjoy using bash?
scripts.translation:
[雷恩]
哇，看你的手臂，你一定很享受使用狂擊吧？

scripts.text: Eh, I... just...

[Leon]
No need to be surprised.
If you use a sword, of course you ought to have a good arm!
In times of only useless and lazy youngsters,
I'm glad I met someone strong like you.
scripts.translation:
[雷恩]
不用驚訝。
如果你使用劍，當然應該有一雙強壯的手臂！
在這個只有無用和懶散年輕人的時代，我很高興能遇到像你這樣強壯的人。

scripts.text:
[Leon]
Nothing to be embarrassed about.
Even if you are a female you need a strong arm to use a sword!
In times of only useless and lazy youngsters,
I'm glad I met someone strong like you.
scripts.translation:
[雷恩]
沒什麼好害羞的。
即使你是女性，使用劍也需要強壯的手臂！
在這個只有無用和懶散年輕人的時代，我很高興能遇到像你這樣強壯的人。

scripts.text:
[Leon]
Yes, I would like to give a present to an awesome swordsman like you.
scripts.translation:
[雷恩]
是的，我想送給像你這樣出色的劍士一份禮物。

scripts.text: What present?
scripts.translation: 什麼禮物？

scripts.text: It's ok.
scripts.translation: 不用了

scripts.text:
[Leon]
Haha nothing special, but a skill to attack the vital point!
scripts.translation:
[雷恩]
哈哈，沒什麼特別的，只是一個攻擊要害的技能！

scripts.text:
[Leon]
...Haha nothing special, just a skill that aims at the vital spot!
scripts.translation:
[雷恩]
...哈哈，沒什麼特別的，只是一個瞄準要害的技能！

scripts.text:
[Leon]
It's a skill I developed recently.
When you use bash, depending on
your level, your opponent can
become stunned.
You have learned bash, haven't you?
scripts.translation:
[雷恩]
這是我最近開發的技能。
當你使用狂擊時，根據你的等級，你的對手可能會眩暈。
你已經學會狂擊了吧？

scripts.text:
[Leon]
When I was a swordsman like you,
I used to enjoy using Bash. Every time, I thought
- maybe the attack would be more powerful
if I use stun at the same time.
scripts.translation:
[雷恩]
當我還是像你一樣的劍士時，我特別喜歡使用狂擊。每次我都想，如果同時使用眩暈效果，攻擊會不會更強力呢。

scripts.text:
[Leon]
I drew back from the battlefield to do research
and finally, I developed this wonderful new skill!
Would you like to learn this skill?
scripts.translation:
[雷恩]
我退居幕後進行研究，終於開發出了這個精彩的新技能！
你想學習這個技能嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: Do you have any advice on how to eat sushi?
scripts.translation: 有什麼關於吃壽司的建議嗎？

scripts.text:
[Leon]
Ok. I'll tell you the requirements.
First you need to have level 5 Bash.
You will also need to prepare 10 Fire Arrows, 10 Silver Arrows, 1 bottle of Banana Juice, 30 Tentacles, and 5 bottles of Royal Jelly.
They are.. somewhat like ingredients.
scripts.translation:
[雷恩]
好的。我來告訴你要求。
首先你需要擁有5級的狂擊。
你還需要準備10支火箭矢、10支銀箭矢、1瓶香蕉汁、30個觸手，以及5瓶蜂膠。
它們算是...某種材料吧。

scripts.text:
[Leon]
come to me again once you have all the materials.
We shall talk then.
scripts.translation:
[雷恩]
等你集齊所有材料後再來找我。
到時候我們再談。

scripts.text:
[Leon]
Hahahahahahahahahaha!
... 
 ... 
 ...
I'm at a loss of words!?
scripts.translation:
[雷恩]
哈哈哈哈哈哈！
...
...
...
我竟然無話可說！？

scripts.text:
[Sushi King Leon]
The best way to eat sushi is
with your hands.
That is the basic.
And dip the fish, not the rice,
in the soy sauce.
scripts.translation:
[壽司之王雷恩]
吃壽司最好的方式是用手拿著吃。
這是基本原則。
而且要把魚蘸醬油，而不是米飯。

scripts.text:
[Sushi King Leon]
That way you get a richer flavor.
Also, always eat the kind that is in season.
Eating in the order of white fish then
blue fish will make it taste better!
Mmm! I like sushi~~!
scripts.translation:
[壽司之王雷恩]
這樣味道會更濃郁。
另外，一定要吃當季的壽司。
先吃白肉魚，再吃青背魚，味道會更好！
嗯~！我喜歡壽司~~！

scripts.text:
[Leon]
Oh, no! I have nothing to offer you!
I can't say nice and fun things to anyone
other than swordsmen!
See you in a better world!
scripts.translation:
[雷恩]
哎呀！我沒有什麼可以送給你的！
除了對劍士，我對別人說不出什麼好聽又有趣的話！
在更好的世界再見！

scripts.text:
[Leon]
Hahahahahahaha!
Hahahahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[雷恩]
哈哈哈哈哈哈！
哈哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Juan]
Mmm? Long time no see!
How are you?
You got stronger than before.
Many expect great things from you.
You can do it.
scripts.translation:
[胡安]
嗯？好久不見！
你還好嗎？
你比以前更強了。
很多人對你寄予厚望。
你可以做到的。

scripts.text:
[?]
What are you?
Eh, still a beginner.
I'm busy, so go train a little more
before coming back.
scripts.translation:
[?]
你是誰？
呃，還是個新手。
我很忙，所以先去多訓練一會兒再回來吧。

scripts.text:
[Juan]
Oh, nice to meet you.
You can be on your way. (smiley~)
scripts.translation:
[胡安]
哦，很高興見到你。
你可以走了。（微笑~）

scripts.text:
[Juan]
Ooh. Young swordsman!
You are ready to learn the
newest skill, Auto Berserk?!
scripts.translation:
[胡安]
噢。年輕的劍士！
你準備好學習最新的技能，自動狂暴狀態了嗎？！

scripts.text: Hoho, I would like to learn it now.
scripts.translation: 呵呵，我想現在學習它

scripts.text: What is that?
scripts.translation: 那是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Juan]
Ok. Then...
scripts.translation:
[胡安]
好的。那麼...

scripts.text:
[Juan]
You have just become a swordsman
that can use Auto Berserk.
You can go about 
and achieve great things!
scripts.translation:
[胡安]
你剛剛成為了一名可以使用自動狂暴狀態的劍士。
你可以去成就一番偉業了！

scripts.text:
[Juan]
Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[胡安]
祝你好運！

scripts.text:
[Juan]
....................................oh yeah.
I forgot to say something.
There are some things you must keep in mind.

[Juan]
Once you regain health,
this skill will subside.
Also, there isn't really a time limit
but it can still disappear when
it is attacked with a skill that can
nullify provoke.
scripts.translation:
[胡安]
一旦你恢復了生命值，這個技能就會消失。
另外，雖然沒有嚴格的時間限制，但如果被能夠解除挑釁的技能攻擊，它也會消失。

scripts.text:
[Juan]
If you don't remember these characteristics,
you may run into some problems on the battlefield
when the skill disappears all of a sudden.
scripts.translation:
[胡安]
如果你不記住這些特性，當技能突然消失時，你在戰場上可能會遇到麻煩。

scripts.text:
[Juan]
Then... bye for real~
scripts.translation:
[胡安]
那麼...真的再見了~

scripts.text:
[Juan]
Auto Berserk?
It's a skill crucial on the battlefield.
When your health is in red,
your hidden potential provokes yourself
to help you in battle.
scripts.translation:
[胡安]
自動狂暴狀態？
這是戰場上至關重要的技能。
當你的生命值變紅時，你隱藏的力量會激發自己，幫助你在戰鬥中作戰。

scripts.text:
[Juan]
It is perfect for those that
fight on the battlefield like fire!
With your ability, you can learn
this skill right now.
Then, I shall tell you the necessary materials.
scripts.translation:
[胡安]
它非常適合那些在戰場上如烈火般戰鬥的人！
憑藉你的能力，你現在就可以學習這個技能。
那麼，我來告訴你所需的材料。

scripts.text:
[Juan]
You need 35 Powder of Butterfly.
The energy from the magnificent
wings of a butterfly will
help you gather your strength!
And 10 Horrendous Mouth.
10 Decayed Nail.
and last but not least...
10 Honey!
scripts.translation:
[胡安]
你需要35個蝴蝶粉。
蝴蝶華麗翅膀中的能量將幫助你聚集力量！
還有10個亡者牙齒。
10個亡者指甲。
最後但同樣重要的是...
10瓶蜂蜜！

scripts.text:
[Juan]
Did you get all that down?
As always, please come back
when you are ready.
I look forward to seeing you again.
scripts.translation:
[胡安]
你都記住了嗎？
像往常一樣，準備好後再回來。
期待再次見到你。

scripts.text:
[Juan]
Oh no, you have more injuries
since the last time I saw you.
You went into battle like this?
Seems like you are straining yourself.
scripts.translation:
[胡安]
哎呀，你比上次見面時受的傷更多了。
你帶著這樣的傷去戰鬥了嗎？
看來你太勉強自己了。

scripts.text:
[Juan]
Even though you may have a lot of strength
you can't do much when you reach your limits so
don't overestimate your powers.
Of course you could always use the
skill we developed to overcome these limits.
scripts.translation:
[胡安]
雖然你可能很有力量，但當你達到極限時，能做的事情就有限了，所以不要高估自己的能力。
當然，你總是可以使用我們開發的技能來突破這些極限。

scripts.text: Eh! What are you talking about?
scripts.translation: 誒！你在說什麼？

scripts.text: Haha, there can't be such a thing.
scripts.translation: 哈哈，不可能有這種東西

scripts.text: Keuuuuuuuh!
scripts.translation: 庫嗚嗚嗚！

scripts.text:
[Juan]
The skill is called Berserk.
It is deemed the flower of a battlefield.
When your health is red,
your hidden potential is provokes yourself
to help you in battle.
scripts.translation:
[胡安]
這個技能叫做狂暴狀態。
它被譽為戰場之花。
當你的生命值變紅時，你隱藏的力量會激發自己，幫助你在戰鬥中作戰。

scripts.text:
[Juan]
It is perfect for those that
fight on the battlefield like fire!
With your ability, you can learn
this skill right now.
Then, I shall tell you the necessary materials.
scripts.translation:
[胡安]
它非常適合那些在戰場上如烈火般戰鬥的人！
憑藉你的能力，你現在就可以學習這個技能。
那麼，我來告訴你所需的材料。

scripts.text:
[Juan]
You need 35 Powder of Butterfly.
The energy from the magnificent
wings of a butterfly will
help you gather your strength!
And 10 Horrendous Mouth.
10 Decayed Nail.
and last but not least...
10 Honeys!
scripts.translation:
[胡安]
你需要35個蝴蝶粉。
蝴蝶華麗翅膀中的能量將幫助你聚集力量！
還有10個亡者牙齒。
10個亡者指甲。
最後但同樣重要的是...
10瓶蜂蜜！

scripts.text:
[Juan]
Did you get all that down?
As always, please come back
when you are ready.
I look forward to seeing you again.
scripts.translation:
[胡安]
你都記住了嗎？
像往常一樣，準備好後再回來。
期待再次見到你。

scripts.text:
[Juan]
Bleh, were you fooled all your life.
I don't know. Don't talk to me.
scripts.translation:
[胡安]
噗，你這一輩子都被騙了嗎。
我不知道。別跟我說話。

scripts.text:
[Juan]
Keuuuuuuuuuuuuuh!
Ooowwwwwuuuuuuuuuuuuuhhh!
Keuaaaaaaaaaaah!
scripts.translation:
[胡安]
庫嗚嗚嗚嗚嗚！
奧嗚嗚嗚嗚嗚！
庫啊啊啊啊啊！

scripts.text:
[Juan]
Are you enjoying your trip?
I hope you have nice days ahead of you.
Ah, I am just a kind knight Juan.
Don't worry about me too much. Hahaha...
scripts.translation:
[胡安]
你旅途愉快嗎？
希望你未來幾天一切順利。
啊，我只是個善良的騎士胡安。
別太擔心我。哈哈哈...
